intro: Baku rewards visitors with a mix of history, culture, and modern flair. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Metro runs 06:00–24:00; fare 0.60 AZN with a Bakı Metropoliten Kart (3 AZN refundable deposit).
Buses cost 0.60 AZN; newer red buses require a metro card for payment.
Taxis: agree on fare beforehand; typical city trip 4–10 AZN. Ride apps like Bolt work.
Driving: speed cameras are common; fines sent by SMS.
Walking: pedestrian zones around Fountain Square and the old town; crossings can be risky at night.
Bikes: city is fairly flat and bike-friendly, but no dedicated lanes.

icherisheher.name: Icherisheher (Old City)
icherisheher.tip: Enter through the gates and wander without a map; the walls, caravanserais and courtyards are the point.

maiden_tower.name: Maiden Tower of Baku
maiden_tower.price_text: ≈ AZN 10–20 entry; check on the day
maiden_tower.hours: Roughly 10:00–18:00 daily; hours vary by season
maiden_tower.tip: Climb to the top for the best Old City rooftop view; the stairs are narrow and steep.

shirvanshahs.name: Palace of the Shirvanshahs
shirvanshahs.price_text: ≈ AZN 10–20 entry; check on the day
shirvanshahs.tip: See the palace, divankhana and mausoleum in one loop; the courtyard is the calmest spot in the Old City.

flame_towers.name: Flame Towers
flame_towers.price_text: Free to view from outside; observation deck price varies
flame_towers.hours: Best seen after dark; deck hours check on the day
flame_towers.tip: View them from the seafront or Highland Park at night, when the LED facade lights up.

heydar_aliyev.name: Heydar Aliyev Center
heydar_aliyev.price_text: ≈ AZN 10–20 entry; check on the day
heydar_aliyev.tip: The Zaha Hadid building is the star; allow time for the curved exterior as well as the exhibitions.

boulevard.name: Baku Boulevard
boulevard.price_text: Free · Baku Eye and boat rides cost extra
boulevard.tip: Walk the full seafront from the Old City to the Carpet Museum; it is long, so pick a stretch.

carpet_museum.name: Azerbaijan Carpet Museum
carpet_museum.price_text: ≈ AZN 5–15 entry; check on the day
carpet_museum.tip: The building is shaped like a rolled carpet. Start on the top floor and work down.

ateshgah.name: Ateshgah of Baku
ateshgah.price_text: ≈ AZN 5–15 entry; check on the day
ateshgah.tip: It is far out on the Absheron peninsula; pair it with Yanar Dag in one taxi trip.

yanar_dag.name: Yanar Dag
yanar_dag.price_text: ≈ AZN 5–15 entry; check on the day
yanar_dag.tip: The natural gas fire is best after dusk; bring a jacket, it is exposed and windy.

bibi_heybat.name: Bibi-Heybat Mosque
bibi_heybat.hours: Open daily; avoid prayer times for visiting
bibi_heybat.tip: Women cover hair and shoulders. The green-tiled facade faces the bay.

dolma.name: Dolma (restaurant)
dolma.hours: Roughly lunch and dinner daily; book ahead
dolma.tip: Order the dolma and the lamb; it is a good first stop for Azerbaijani home cooking in the Old City.

nizami_street.name: Nizami Street
nizami_street.tip: The pedestrian stretch near Fountain Square is best in the evening, when the cafes fill up.

yasil_bazar.name: Yasil Bazar
yasil_bazar.price_text: Free to enter; pay for what you buy
yasil_bazar.tip: Go in the morning for fruit, cheese and herbs; bring small cash and taste before buying.

fountain_square.name: Fountain Square
fountain_square.tip: The social heart of the city; sit at a cafe and watch the evening crowd.

highland_park.name: Highland Park viewpoint
highland_park.tip: Take the funicular up, then walk down past the Martyrs' Alley for the best bay panorama.

old_city_walk.name: Old City walking tour
old_city_walk.hours: Tours usually run morning and afternoon
old_city_walk.tip: A guide explains the caravanserais and hammams you would otherwise walk past; book a small group.

carpet_shop.name: Carpet and antique shops in the Old City
carpet_shop.tip: Haggle politely and ask about the origin of a carpet before any price talk.

tea_house.name: Traditional tea house (cay evi)
tea_house.tip: Order black tea with jam and a plate of dried fruit; it is the cheapest way to slow down.

boat_trip.name: Baku Bay boat trip
boat_trip.price_text: ≈ AZN 10–30 per person; check on the day
boat_trip.hours: Weather dependent; usually daytime and evening
boat_trip.tip: Short trips leave from the Boulevard; confirm the price and duration before boarding.

mud_volcanoes.name: Mud volcanoes tour (Gobustan)
mud_volcanoes.tip: Combine Gobustan rock art with the mud volcanoes; confirm pickup and entry fees are included.

funicular.name: Baku Funicular
funicular.price_text: ≈ AZN 1 per ride; check on the day
funicular.tip: Ride up to Highland Park and walk back down; the queue is shorter in the morning.

martyrs_alley.name: Martyrs' Alley (Shehidler Khiyabani)
martyrs_alley.tip: A solemn memorial with a long view over the bay; dress and behave respectfully.

stays.why: Inside the walls, walk to Maiden Tower and the Palace of the Shirvanshahs. Quiet lanes, but narrow streets and few cars.
The pedestrian heart of the city: cafés, shops and easy walks to the Old City and the boulevard.
Water views and a long promenade; good for evening walks. A bit further from the Old City lanes.
Central shopping street with many mid-range hotels and metro access nearby.

food: Try plov (rice with meat or saffron), dushbara dumplings in broth, and kebab with sumac onions.
Tea is a ritual: order çay with jam, walnuts and sweets at a çay evi (tea house).
Qutab is a thin stuffed flatbread, cheap and filling; good for a quick lunch.
Look for pomegranate dishes and fresh herbs in season; the fruit is a local symbol.
Prices vary; a simple local meal is often well under 20 AZN. Check the bill and confirm prices in tourist areas.
more_time: Add a day trip to Gobustan for the petroglyphs and mud volcanoes; check tour prices and road conditions on the day.
Swap an afternoon for the Fire Temple at Ateshgah and Yanar Dag, the burning hillside; best as a guided trip.
Spend a slow half-day at the Heydar Aliyev Center for the architecture and exhibitions.
